headline: GM to Expand Hybrid Lineup as US Gasoline Prices Hold Above $4
summary: General Motors plans to introduce hybrid options across multiple segments as high fuel prices and slowing electric vehicle adoption weigh on traditional automotive sales.
why: General Motors is one of the world's largest legacy automakers, navigating the transition from combustion engines to electrified vehicles amid shifting consumer demand.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: Shifting toward hybrids addresses consumer demand during high fuel prices but requires significant capital reallocations.

why_moved: Persistent high gasoline prices and lagging EV sales force legacy automakers to alter product roadmaps toward hybrid offerings to protect market share.
